title: Where a panel's color comes from

blocks.content: Explore the panels on Sample Website Dashboard to see which keep palette colors and which take their color from a threshold.

blocks.title: Where a panel's color comes from

blocks.content: Find the panels titled **Memory / CPU**, **logins**, **server requests**, and **client side full page load**. These panels use **Classic palette**, so Grafana assigns each series a color based on its order.

Find the gauges titled **Memory** and **Google hits**, the stats titled **Support calls** and **Sign ups**, and the bar gauge titled **Google hits**. These panels use **From thresholds (by value)**, so each takes its color from the matching threshold.
